title: Task instruction for forecasted Other Revenue % of Operating Revenue directly contradicts the ground-truth workbook
evidence: In problem.py:34, the task instructions explicitly state: "In the Revenue Drivers sheet, reference actual Other Revenue from another tab, and then hardcode the % of Operating Revenue for the forecasted years as the same value as the last actual year’s value. From that, calculate forecasted Other Revenue." In 'Revenue Drivers'!H138 (2025A, the last actual year), the % of Operating Revenue is =H137/'Consolidated P&L'!G5 = 4.8948374 / 3184.843377 = 0.00153691620609951 (~0.15%). However, in the ground-truth workbook (gt_01_Education_golden.xlsx), 'Revenue Drivers'!I138:M138 is NOT hardcoded to the last actual year's value (0.00153691620609951); instead, I138 contains the formula ='Key Assumptions'!D9 (which is 0.02, i.e., 2.0% 'Other Income as % of Revenue') and J138:M138 chain =I138, =J138, =K138, =L138 (all evaluating to 0.02). Because 'Revenue Drivers'!I137:M137 (=I138*I135 ... =M138*M135) feeds 'Consolidated P&L'!H6:L6 (Other Revenue), this contradiction cascades into 399 of the 680 modification cells across 8 sheets ('DCF Valuation': 83 cells, 'Consolidated P&L': 97 cells, 'Ratio Analysis': 92 cells, 'Consolidated BS': 40 cells, 'Working Capital Schedule': 38 cells, 'Consolidated CF': 34 cells, 'Revenue Drivers': 10 cells, 'Forecast': 5 cells). Following the explicit prompt instruction yields modification = 0.4132 (281/680) and a score of 0.0 on the sole verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1).
confirmation: Confirmed: GT I138:M138 evaluate to 0.02 from 'Key Assumptions'!D9 while H138 (2025A) = 4.8948/3184.84 = 0.00153692, and I137:M137 feed Consolidated P&L row 6 and onward. So the explicit instruction contradicts the key across hundreds of modification cells.
fix: gt_01_Education_golden.xlsx: 'Revenue Drivers'!I138 changed from ='Key Assumptions'!D9 (2%) to the hardcoded last-actual-year value 0.00153691620609951 (= H138, 4.8948374/3184.843377). J138:M138 keep their =I138 chain. Cached values were recomputed in LibreOffice: 424 dependent cells changed (Revenue Drivers 137/138, Consolidated P&L, BS, CF, Ratio Analysis, Working Capital, Forecast, DCF), no formulas or formats changed. DCF Valuation!C22 is now 2238.42836435011, matching the three runs that followed the prompt.

title: The instruction says to carry forward the last actual year's Other Revenue %, but the answer key uses the 2% Key Assumption
evidence: problem.py tells the agent to "hardcode the % of Operating Revenue for the forecasted years as the same value as the last actual year's value". In the ground truth, Revenue Drivers!H138 (FY2025, the last actual year) = H137/'Consolidated P&L'!G5 = 0.15369%. The forecast cells do not use that value. GT I138 is ='Key Assumptions'!D9 ("Other Income as % of Revenue" = 0.02) and J138:M138 = prior cell, so every forecast year is 2.00%. An agent that follows the instruction gets I137 = 0.0015369*3617.19 ≈ 5.56. The GT has I137 = 72.34 (and J:M 85.93/116.93/157.95/210.90). The difference flows into Consolidated P&L row 6, Total Revenue (row 9), the CAGR in M9, the Working Capital, CF and Ratio sheets, and the DCF. All of these are 'modification' cells. verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (weight 1, the only verifier) is all-or-nothing: every modification cell must match. So a correct reading of the instruction scores 0. Also, the GT uses a formula link rather than a 'hardcode'.
confirmation: GT I137 = 72.34 (2% x 3617.19) versus about 5.56 under the instructed carry-forward of 0.1537%. GT also uses a formula link rather than a hardcode, so following the instruction fails the all-or-nothing verifier.
fix: gt_01_Education_golden.xlsx: 'Revenue Drivers'!I138 changed from ='Key Assumptions'!D9 (2%) to the hardcoded last-actual-year value 0.00153691620609951 (= H138, 4.8948374/3184.843377). J138:M138 keep their =I138 chain. Cached values were recomputed in LibreOffice: 424 dependent cells changed (Revenue Drivers 137/138, Consolidated P&L, BS, CF, Ratio Analysis, Working Capital, Forecast, DCF), no formulas or formats changed. DCF Valuation!C22 is now 2238.42836435011, matching the three runs that followed the prompt.

title: Ground truth contradicts the required Other Revenue forecast assumption
evidence: The instruction says to hardcode forecast Other Revenue percentages to the last actual year's value. The supplied FY2025 actuals are Other Revenue of 4.8948374 and Operating Revenue of 3184.843377, giving 0.1536916206%. However, golden Revenue Drivers!I138 references 'Key Assumptions'!D9, which is 2%, and J138:M138 carry that forward. Consequently, golden I137 expects 72.343845 rather than 5.5593213896. These differences exceed the verifier's 1% tolerance. Following the explicit instruction therefore fails the sole, weight-1, all-or-nothing verifier.
